title: Runtime plan artifact blocks finalize
description: agent-run-plan.md runtime dirty repeatedly blocks integration or finalize.
impact: Finalize and integration can stall on generated runtime artifacts.
root_cause: Runtime execution plans are treated like durable source artifacts.
evidence: finalize or integration blocked by runtime plan file

title: Completed event missing for existing result
description: Result artifact exists but completed event is absent from event stream.
impact: Queue and status readers disagree on whether work is complete.
root_cause: Completion reconciliation trusts events only and does not backfill from result artifacts.
evidence: result exists but completed event missing

title: Agent report schema fields missing
description: Agent reports miss fields required by parse / diagnose / decision, causing HOLD.
impact: Closed-loop decision cannot safely continue without normalized report fields.
root_cause: Report schema compliance is not enforced before result parsing.

title: Route plan misses required Agent
description: Natural language routes miss required Agents such as A2/A3 for protected attachment or authorization signals.
impact: Security or backend implementation work can be skipped in closed-loop dispatch.
root_cause: Router keyword and fail-down policy did not fully encode Phoenix-specific signals.
evidence: protected attachment did not trigger A2/A3
menu code and role authorization did not trigger A2/A3

title: Queue bookkeeping conflict
description: Queue JSON bookkeeping conflicts repeatedly during integration.
impact: Integration requires conflict handling and can delay safe merge.
root_cause: Mutable queue JSON is used as both write model and read model.

title: A5 data readiness route omitted
description: Natural language requests mentioning readiness, master data, store/company/account/role mapping can miss A5.
impact: Data readiness checks can be skipped before Store Payment pilot work.
root_cause: Data readiness signals were not represented as mandatory A5 fail-down triggers.
evidence: readiness request selected A1/A2 but missed A5

title: User forced to manually sync baseline
description: User was forced to manually rebase, merge, or clean docs/ops/runs between Agent tasks.
impact: Agent platform work leaks low-level lifecycle operations to the user.
root_cause: Baseline sync lifecycle was not consistently attached to every Agent execution path.
